This editorial illustration features a purple background with red and white text. The word "TEMPO" is prominently displayed in large red capital letters at the top, accompanied by the number "55." Below, the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appears in small red letters.

The central figure is a large, stylized man with a round face, small eyes, and short dark hair. He wears a light blue, short-sleeved button-up shirt with two breast pockets and tan trousers. His hands are behind his back.

Behind him are two smaller men. The man on the left, wearing a dark grey long-sleeved shirt and black pants, holds a silver sword with a gold hilt in his right hand. The man on the right, dressed in a dark olive green shirt and pants, holds a gold-colored balance scale. Both men are positioned as if peering out from behind the central figure.

White text on the right reads "PERANG DINGIN DUA SEKONDAN," followed by a paragraph of Indonesian text. Additional text and a barcode are visible at the bottom right.
